result.notes:
foundation.ts typechecks with no errors of its own. I loaded it at runtime and ran its 26 records through buildBook. Every define* validated. The only problems are the 17 expected `cycle` findings: 15 concepts and 2 components. There are no dangling or undefined links. Nothing is imported from sibling files, so `missing` is empty.

How the old code looks:
- Concept dependencies come from the `#<concept>` imports in packages/backend/src/<c>. Test files are left out (`*.test.ts`, `*.fixture.ts`, `tests/`). Each concept's `was` lists the README, its CONTEXT-MAP row, and the first import line for each dependency. `lines` counts the non-test .ts lines under src/<c> only.
- 15 of the 17 concepts form one import loop. Only indexing and operator are outside it. Neither has an index.ts door or an entry in the backend's `#<concept>` import map, and only their own convex registrations import them.
- payments imports 11 of the 16 other concepts.
- parties imports `#payments` only from its tests, so payments is not in its dependsOn.
- The old CONTEXT-MAP says 16 concepts but lists 17.
- Components loop as well. convex-backend reads ponder-indexer through INDEXER_URL. ponder-indexer fetches the backend Site's JWKS (apps/indexer/src/auth.ts:42, :92), even though its README says it never calls Convex.
- A loop cannot be written as consts that hold each other. So the affected records start with an empty mutable `dependsOn`. A local `wire()` helper fills it once every record in the loop exists and checks it again against ConceptSpec or ComponentSpec. The helper is not exported.

Components:
- chain: evm, exposes http, no dependencies.
- aa-gateway: node, http, depends on chain. On devnet this role is played by alto plus @pimlico/mock-paymaster, not the aa-gateway package.
- ponder-indexer: ponder, http and sql, depends on chain and convex-backend.
- convex-backend: convex, rpc, http and ws, depends on chain, aa-gateway and ponder-indexer.
- core-sdk: "node, browser", exposes none, depends on convex-backend and ponder-indexer. It never holds a chain RPC URL or a bundler.
- cli: node, cli, depends on core-sdk and convex-backend. It calls the Site directly for native revoke and `dev key`.

Actors: 21 in total. 16 are persons: anyone, person, founder, member, director, board, office-holder, payer, payee, invitee, investor, shareholder, grantee, owner, developer, operator. 3 are agents: agent, ai-seat, assistant. 2 are systems: system-job, bridge. They are taken from the old book's `who:` lines, which are cited in the system's `was`.

Surfaces: cli, sdk, react, mcp, http.

Environments:
- devnet: bootMs is 80000, the measured upper end of the 40–80 s `up` cost (packages/devnet/README.md:66), without the indexer.
- staging: no bootMs, because no measurement exists.
- The two runbooks disagree on what triggers the staging release. environments.md:187 says master; deploy.md:361 says integration/main (CAP-1020). This is recorded in staging's `deploy`.
- docs/canon/environment-and-deployment.md does not exist in the old repo. I used docs/runbooks/environments.md and docs/runbooks/deploy.md instead.
